| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="kafka-*" span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0 AND value>=prev_value, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats avg(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" pod="kafka-*" resource="cpu" container="kafka" span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)
| fields - used capacity

title: Enterprise Confluent Observability (Tier 1/2/3)
description: Three-tier cross-cutting view of the CFK deployment: Tier 1 infrastructure (per-component CPU/memory gauges vs limits, plus CPU/memory/JVM heap/GC trends, across Kafka, Connect, Schema Registry, Control Center, KRaft Controller pods only), Tier 2 platform/protocol health (controller/partition state, broker saturation, P99 request latency, KRaft quorum, Connect task status, Schema Registry leadership), and Tier 3 business/pipeline outcome (topic throughput, consumer lag, connector data quality as rates, sink latency, source production rate, topic data volume). ksqlDB, REST Proxy, and the CFK operator itself are excluded per scope.
